[[File:Parade_on_Naboo.png|thumb|right|300px|Parade on Naboo]]
A '''parade''' was a celebration where people, ships, and animals marched or rode down the streets of a [[City/Legends|city]]. Often times [[Band/Legends|bands]] marched while playing [[Music/Legends|music]], such as the case was with the [[Great Municipal Band/Legends|Great Municipal Band]] during the victory parade after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].
